preflight: xcodebuild build-for-testing SimulatorSigned with the CPU-raster XCFramework
xcodebuild test-without-building ... three exact-route host tests
notes: Feed and Official post identifiers use separate versioned Base64 Codable snapshots. Root-only legacy values remain accepted, and malformed snapshots fail closed.
The process-relaunch XCTest terminates the app and relaunches without route injection for both Feed and Official, preserving identifiers containing Unicode, slashes and query characters.
Focused-post changes and closes update the persisted route only when no pending destination owns navigation. Authentication upgrade retains the exact restored post.

The first executable attempt used stock Skiko and crashed in ComposeHostingViewController.viewWillAppear because the Hyper-V guest exposes no Metal service. LLDB preserved that diagnosis. The accepted build passed the documented exact CPU-raster dependency preflight and all focal tests.

Independent review reported no actionable regression in persistence, restoration or authentication-upgrade behavior. Its local Node execution was sandbox-limited; the primary lane separately passed the affected contracts and XCTest gates.
No backend, credentials, product data or remote state were used. Generated Xcode project output was removed and the Product SHA was clean after execution.
This closes the iOS exact Feed/Official post-route relaunch limit. Scroll, drafts, editor state, media playback position and general secondary backstacks remain owned by their existing units.

After #541 merged, the unit rebased to Product SHA a607c582. Its runtime and test patch is equivalent to the executed 9ee67bd9 product; the only additional product metadata change refreshes the reviewed capability-matrix hash for the resulting QuataIosApp.swift composition, so the focused XCTest evidence was not repeated.

Any executable or test change after productSha invalidates this evidence. Documentation-only attestation commits remain valid only when scripts/validate-candidate-attestation.mjs accepts the real diff.
